'''Ian Gregory McCall''' (born July 5, 1984) is a retired American [[mixed martial arts|mixed martial artist]] who competed in the [[Flyweight (MMA)|Flyweight]] and [[Bantamweight (MMA)|Bantamweight]] divisions of several prominent MMA promotions, including [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]], [[Rizin Fighting Federation]] and [[World Extreme Cagefighting]]. He is also a former [[Tachi Palace Fights#Current champions|TPF Flyweight Champion]]. In between his fights in January 2015 and December 2017, he had been booked for six consecutive cancelled fights, four of which were cancelled during the week of.

==Background==
